title: Summer Camp Session 1
description: Our first official week of summer camp kicks off at Camp Lawton! Scouts will earn merit badges and practice outdoor woodcraft.

title: Summer Camp Session 2
description: Second week of scouts summer camp. Features the annual Mt. Lemmon Wilderness Trek and the Friday Night Campfire Program.

title: Wood Badge Leadership Training
description: Advanced training course for adult leaders, focusing on leadership skills, team development, and outdoor stewardship.

title: Council Volunteer Beaver Day
description: Join our council volunteers for a day of camp service. Help winterize tents, clear brush for fire safety, and maintain trails.
